name: M3_CRS420MI_LstByActDate
description: List application messages sorted by action date ascending. Returns messages that notify responsible users about changes affecting their area, such as when related records are changed or deleted. Each record includes identifiers, sender and receiver, message type and status, action and completion dates, removal date, short description, registration date and time, bookmark and workflow information, plus user-defined data areas.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which to list application messages.

inputParameters.name: ADAT
inputParameters.description: Action date used to select and sort application messages.

inputParameters.name: REC2
inputParameters.description: User who should receive the application messages to be listed; blank selects the current user.

inputParameters.name: FSTS
inputParameters.description: Lowest message status value to include in the selection range.

inputParameters.name: TSTS
inputParameters.description: Highest message status value to include in the selection range.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number.
